Ice and citrus peels or disposal cleaner

Check for pests (entry points, traps, droppings)
Test garage door auto-reverse; lubricate tracks
Inspect caulk and grout in bathrooms and kitchen
Clean gutters and downspouts; check drainage away from foundation
Service HVAC (AC in spring, furnace in fall)
Check exterior caulking, siding, and paint
Clean windows and screens; check weatherstripping

Task: Drain a few gallons from water heater; test pressure relief valve
Test sump pump (pour water in pit)
Start up/winterize lawn equipment and sprinklers
Trim trees and shrubs away from house and roof
Seal gaps and cracks in driveway and walkways
Chimney and fireplace inspection and sweep
Notes: Before first use of the season

Task: Fully flush water heater; check anode rod 2-3 years
Inspect crawlspace or basement (moisture, mold, cracks, pests)
Drain and winterize outdoor faucets and irrigation
Pressure wash siding, deck, and driveway
Operate main water shutoff and other shutoff valves
Review electrical panel for scorch marks or tripped breakers
Notes: Visual check only; call an electrician for problems

Task: Replace batteries in garage remotes, thermostat, and locks
Review home insurance; update home inventory
